content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe position themselves as go-to solutions for course creators, providing user-friendly interfaces and payment processing capabilities. However, their offerings come with significant drawbacks for those in restricted regions. Teachable charges monthly fees and limits the number of courses on lower tiers, while Stripe imposes geographical restrictions that exclude many creators. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack eliminates these barriers. For a one-time fee of $197, it enables you to host your store on Cloudflare Pages with backend support through Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. This setup allows for extensive customization without ongoing costs or limitations, providing a true sense of ownership over your products and sales process.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Teachable and Stripe often restrict access based on geographical location, which is a primary concern for many creators in Nigeria. This can lead to frustrated users who cannot leverage their expertise due to financial infrastructure limitations. These platforms impose strict compliance measures that result in many creators being unable to accept payments. On the other hand, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed from the ground up to enable creators in regions overlooked by mainstream payment processors. With automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the geographical constraints often imposed by traditional options. This means that your ability to sell courses is no longer contingent on where you live.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are critical considerations. Teachable and Stripe typically charge transaction fees that can accumulate quickly, reducing your overall earnings. Additionally, the payment confirmation process can be slow, causing delays in cash flow that hinder your ability to reinvest in your business. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a more streamlined solution. With a transaction fee of only 0.5% via NOWPayments, you benefit from rapid payment processing through on-chain verification. Most transactions on recommended networks like BSC and Solana are under $0.10, meaning you keep more of your profits. This efficiency ensures you receive payments quickly, allowing for seamless business operations.
Take control of your online sales without geographical restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the major drawbacks of using platforms like Teachable is that you don’t own your customer data or the infrastructure your courses are hosted on. If the platform decides to change its policies or imposes new fees, you can be left with little recourse. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack guarantees ownership of your entire setup. Once deployed, you control your store's data as well as the sale and delivery of your courses. The integration with automated delivery systems ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly without manual intervention. This level of control is essential for long-term success, as it allows you to build meaningful relationships with your audience while maintaining flexibility.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture to sell your courses depends on your unique needs and the constraints you face. If you're in Nigeria and struggling with payment processing options, platforms like Teachable or Stripe are not viable long-term solutions. Instead, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a more appropriate architecture for creators like you. It provides an easy-to-implement solution with robust features that allow you to quickly set up your store and start selling courses without ongoing subscriptions or dependence on external platforms. This sovereignty allows you to focus on creating quality content while having the infrastructure to support your business needs.

For digital creators in Nigeria, the critical factor in choosing a platform is access and ownership. Traditional platforms like Teachable and Stripe may exclude you due to geographical restrictions, severely limiting your ability to monetize your knowledge. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, specifically the Edge Commerce Stack, offers a powerful alternative, allowing you to build and manage your online store without relying on external processing services. This empowers you to take control of your business while efficiently managing payments and product delivery.
Experience true ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure.

The combination of Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments provides a robust foundation for any digital creator ready to break free from conventional limitations.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for the Edge Commerce Stack at COREMERCH for $197. 2. Set up Cloudflare Pages for your website hosting, ensuring it's live and accessible. 3. Use Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, integrating it with your store. 4. Configure Supabase as your order storage solution, enabling efficient management of customer data. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions with a low fee of 0.5%. 6. Load at least five products onto your store, ensuring all are correctly linked for delivery. 7. Test the entire setup to ensure functionality, including payment processing and product delivery. 8. Launch your store and begin marketing your courses to potential customers.
